story.title: The Legacy of Aari Silk
story.description: Founded in the sacred loom lanes of Kanchipuram, Aari Silk Couture honors centuries of South Indian bridal heritage through pure handloom weaving and authentic zari craft.

footer.bio: Aari Silk Couture is an authentic bridal handloom couture house celebrating South Indian silk traditions, pure zari weaves, and heirloom bridal ensembles.
